scope: Authored source files in the primary workspace, preserving authoritative repository files and byte-identical differing mirror variants. Not a runtime-data or model backup.
excluded: datasets, responses, logs, run outputs and weights
virtual environments, caches and notebook checkpoints
alternative Git worktrees, SP-820-publish separate project, backups/archive and restart-n5-freezes snapshots
mirror_conflict_policy: Repository sources remain canonical; different workspace mirrors are retained under archives/workspace-source-variants without replacing active methods.
